name: communitycollegesearcher
description: Search courses (in-person / online / hybrid) across all California Community Colleges. Local SQLite database, a scraper backend that updates it, and a search frontend.

scripts.cid:fetch: mkdir -p src/data/cid && curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://data-c-idsystem.org/descriptors/final/csv -o src/data/cid/descriptors.csv && curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://data-c-idsystem.org/courses/csv -o src/data/cid/courses.csv && echo 'C-ID CSVs downloaded to src/data/cid/'
